The perfect roast potatoes. Crispy on the outside, tender but still has a bite to it in the middle.

== Ingredients ==
* 5 large red-skinned or small Russet [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], cut into 1 ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] cubes
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* [[Cookbook:Flour|Flour]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine olive oil, Italian seasoning, and garlic. Set aside.
#Cook potatoes in a large pot of [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] salted water until slightly tougher than tender.
#Drain potatoes, then dredge in flour. Set out on a cooling rack and let dry for 1 hour.
#Add potatoes to oil mixture and toss to coat. Spread out in a single layer on a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]]. 
#Season potatoes with a small handful of salt and a lot of freshly-ground black pepper.
#Place in the bottom third of a 500°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until well browned and crispy on the outside (15–20 minutes), stirring halfway through.
#Serve warm.
